# dsh-vedar — Vedar (Kamchatka travel) MCP server for DeepSeek Harness
中文
**Vedar** (vedarai.ru, Russian name Ведар) is the travel platform of the Kamchatka peninsula, Russia
. Its public MCP server gives AI agents live tours and availability from local operators, the safety
status of places and routes (volcanoes, earthquakes, weather warnings), weather, stays, gear rental
, transfers and trip plans. No auth, rate-limited by IP.
This plugin does one thing: it registers one instance of the official bridge `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-c
lient` in your DeepSeek Harness profile, pointed at `https://vedarai.ru/api/mcp`. After install the
model calls the tools as `mcp__vedar__<tool>`.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm, so pnpm must be on PATH (`npm i -g pnpm`); without it the command sto
ps with "pnpm was not found".
Restart `dsh web`. The tools appear before the first turn.
No plugin? Put the same row into `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` (identical to `cordis.patch.
yml` in this repository):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or add it by URL in a settings panel (`dsh-mcp-center`, `dsh-mcp-panel`, `dsh-mcp-connector`): type
Streamable HTTP, URL `https://vedarai.ru/api/mcp`, auth none.
## Tools (20)
Read: `get_tours`, `get_tour_details`, `get_tour_availability`, `get_place_info`, `get_volcano_statu
s`, `safety_status`, `get_guardian_context`, `get_weather`, `search_accommodations`, `search_gear`,
`search_transfers`, `make_trip_plan`, `edit_trip_plan`, `get_request_status`, `search`, `fetch`.
Write, four requests confirmed by a human, no online payment: `create_lead`, `create_booking_request
`, `create_stay_request`, `request_charter`.
Platform data is in Russian; tool arguments work best in Russian or English. Emergency number in Kam
a is in Russian; tool arguments work best in Russian or English. Emergency number in Kamchatka: 112.
## Status
DeepSeek Harness is in developer preview and config fields may change. The row in this plugin follow
s the README of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 0.2.0-rc.2 (checked 2026-10-13). Verified end to end o
n 2026-10-14 with dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 and pnpm 10.28.0 (headless profile, GitHub Actions runner): the plu
gin installed with the command above, and DeepSeek answered a Chinese question about brown bears in
August by calling 17 Vedar tools, all completed. Please report problems at tourhabk-ui/pos.
Русский: плагин DeepSeek Harness, который одной командой подключает MCP-сервер Ведара. Исходник живё
т в `integrations/dsh-vedar/` репозитория платформы.
